sql_reading_A.note:
دي قراءة deduplicated department: department يظهر مرة واحدة فقط، ومع التداخل أعطينا UnitsStats أولوية.
لكن الأولوية نفسها غير منصوص عليها في السؤال، وده سبب الـ ambiguity.
sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH units_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
        VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units,
        STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units,
        COUNT(*) AS subject_count
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
      ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
    GROUP BY
        d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN 1 END) > 0
),
top_subjects_2022 AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) DESC,
                     d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
        ) AS rn
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
      ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
      AND NOT (
          d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
          AND c.SUBJECT_NUMBER = '17'
      )
    GROUP BY
        d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        avg_total_units,
        variance_total_units,
        stddev_total_units,
        subject_count,
        'UnitsStats' AS reason
    FROM units_stats

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        t.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        t.subject_count,
        'TopSubjects2022'
    FROM top_subjects_2022 t
    WHERE t.rn <= 10
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM units_stats u
          WHERE u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE
      )
)
SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    avg_total_units,
    variance_total_units,
    stddev_total_units,
    subject_count,
    reason
FROM combined;

question_text: For subjects in the current academic term that are in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the maximum total units within each school, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
